content.title: Telefonica Brasil's second-quarter net profit up 10%
content.summary: Telecommunications operator Telefonica Brasil reported on Monday a 10% increase in its net profit for the second quarter from the same quarter last year. The company posted a net profit of 1.34 billion reais ($239.8 million), compared with the 1.37 billion reais expected by analysts, according to an LSEG IBES poll. WHY IT'S IMPORTANT Telefonica Brasil, which is controlled by Spain's Telefonica, is the largest mobile service provider in Brazil by total mobile phone lines, according to data from local telecom regulator Anatel.
